curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what affects stopping distance, the three-to-four-second rule and how to count it, longer gaps, wet pavement, looking ahead and scanning.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Distance and timing cards; contrast card for following time versus look-ahead time.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on following and stopping distance.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when headlights are required, low beams in bad weather, stopping within your headlights, high-beam rules and glare.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per headlight rule; contrast card for the two five-hundred-foot rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on headlights and night driving.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach trip planning, lights and equipment, windows and tires, theft prevention, the pre-start routine, mirrors and the ignition lock.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Checklist cards; contrast card for blind spots versus mirror setting.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on preparing to drive.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach roadside emergency risk, staying in the car, locking up, hitchhikers, flat tires, parking safely, suspicious people, carjacking and disabled vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Safety and breakdown cards; contrast cards for staying in versus leaving the car.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on personal safety and breakdowns.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach staying at the scene, getting aid, moving drivable vehicles, exchanging information and when to notify police.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Crash duty cards; contrast card for moving the car versus notifying police.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do after a crash.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how common and costly deer crashes are, reporting, prevention, seasons and times, groups of deer, myths and what to do if a crash is unavoidable.
Teach pulling over for an officer, behavior during the stop, documents, disputes and officer directions.
